fields.name: pre_press_target
fields.description: Despite its legacy name, store the [y, x] center of the goal-selected demonstration target for the instruction's cube. Read the temporal relation from the goal: for 'right before', select the last completed target placement before the demonstration button press; for 'right after', select the first completed target placement after that press. Remaining on the old target immediately after button contact is not a new placement. Identify completed placements from release and subsequent resting evidence, allowing occlusion; do not substitute a later or final placement. Match the selected target through the demonstration to its center in the execution-start scene despite occlusion and small centroid shifts. Write this at decision step #1 and retain it unchanged thereafter. If the selected target cannot be identified, write "unknown". e.g. [126, 145]
